contract: offline artifact / fault-injection corpus (fix-dv-19.03) for google-auth — sibling of 19.01/19.02. Each case injects a fault, runs a state/output ORACLE (not a provider stub judging itself), records exit/trace/environment. DV-19: the counterexample FAILS pre-fix, PASSES post-fix, verified by STATE/OUTPUTS, release-tied.
release_tie: the fix ships in a tagged release; a counterexample that passes pre-fix is not a fix

environment.note: OAuth/session stubs are inputs, never the oracle

cases.fault: client_secret/refresh_token stored in a signed (not encrypted) session cookie
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (the holder base64-decodes client_secret from the signed cookie)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (tokens kept server-side; the cookie carries only a session id)

cases.fault: credential resolution documented as attached-SA → local ADC → env
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (wrong order: an attached SA shadows an explicit env credential)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (env → local ADC → attached SA, Google's documented order)

cases.fault: one OAuth2 client mutated per request; state compared with undefined===undefined
cases.prefix_expect: FAIL (a callback with no state passes; undefined===undefined)
cases.postfix_expect: PASS (per-request client; state stored, TTL, single-use consumed; missing rejected)
